scopes.BOOTSTRAP: No application session. Authority comes only from a presented credential proof or single-use secret verified server-side. Membership/scope steps are not evaluated; the operation never reads or writes tenant data beyond the secret's own bound target.
scopes.SELF: Target identity is the session identity, resolved server-side. No client-supplied identity ID is accepted. Membership step is skipped; capability comes from the `self` baseline bundle held by every ACTIVE Identity.
scopes.LOCATION: Request carries an explicit (organizationId, locationId) tuple (TEN-2). Actor must hold an ACTIVE Membership for exactly that organization and location, or an ACTIVE organization-wide Membership for that organization.
scopes.ORGANIZATION: Request carries an explicit organizationId. Actor must hold an ACTIVE organization-wide Membership (locationId NULL) for that organization.
scopes.RECORD: AutomationActor only. Scope is the record's immutable `authoritative_scope`; the principal must be registered for that operation and scope class (AGT-9).
scopes.INTERNAL: Not exposed on any route and holds no grant. Invoked only inside another governed operation's transaction by the owning module's command boundary.
scopes.BLOCKED: No bundle holds the capability. Every request fails closed (403 when routed). Unblocking requires the named dependency.

self.holder: Every ACTIVE Identity, independent of membership

learner.holder: Holder of an ACTIVE learner grant on a Membership

observer.holder: Holder of an ACTIVE observer grant on a Membership

manager.holder: Holder of an ACTIVE manager grant on a location Membership

org_admin.holder: Holder of an ACTIVE org_admin grant on an organization-wide Membership (locationId NULL)

evaluation_order.name: membership
evaluation_order.check: ACTIVE Membership in the requested organization (TEN-8, TEN-10)

evaluation_order.name: scope
evaluation_order.check: Requested tuple exactly matches an authorized scope; zero or ambiguous selection fails (TEN-6, TEN-7, TEN-9)

evaluation_order.name: capability
evaluation_order.check: A held bundle includes the operation capability (AUTHZ-7, AUTHZ-13)

evaluation_order.name: target
evaluation_order.check: Target resolved server-side and inside actor scope; wrong tenant / location / reporting scope / nonexistent all identical (AUTHZ-14, AUTHZ-16)

evaluation_order.name: entitlement
evaluation_order.check: Organization-owned entitlement does not remove the capability effect (AUTHZ-8, AUTHZ-21)

post_authorization_outcomes.note: Evaluated after step 4 so unauthorized actors cannot probe payload schemas; before any handler effect (API-2, API-3).
Only after steps 1-6 pass; no side effect.
E.g. IssueCertification while no approved criteria version can exist.

automation_principal_record_shape.capabilities: explicit list of capability IDs; never a bundle name
automation_principal_record_shape.credential: workload credential reference (secret-version ID only, never the secret, REL-6)

operations.target_resolution: Identity resolved from the credential proof only (password; OAuth provider subject after IDN-4 linking). Never from a client-supplied identity ID.
preconditions: Identity status ACTIVE (IDN-14)
PIN credential type rejected: PIN authentication unavailable (IDN-30)
Unknown identity, wrong secret and inactive identity return byte-identical 401 bodies
operations.idempotency_proposed: NONE (each success creates a new session; replay of the request is a new sign-in)
operations.audit_on_success: Success: AuthenticateIdentity audit in same transaction as session creation. Failure: credential-abuse denial record, rate-limited (OQ-AUD-3).

operations.target_resolution: Identity already authenticated by the invoking operation.
preconditions: Invoked only by AuthenticateIdentity or step-up reauthentication
Any credential presented before authentication is never upgraded (SES-19)
operations.audit_on_success: Covered by the invoking operation's audit record.

operations.target_resolution: SELF path: session identity. Token path (BOOTSTRAP): the identity bound to the ACTIVE SetupToken/PasswordResetToken.
preconditions: SELF path requires reverification of the current credential in the same request
Token path requires an ACTIVE, unexpired token; token consumed in the same transaction (IDN-26)
Revokes ALL sessions of the identity atomically (OQ-IDN-3 proposed value)
No manager path exists (IDN-13)
operations.idempotency_proposed: SERVER_DERIVED from token ID on the token path; SELF path is not retried automatically
operations.audit_on_success: ChangeCredential audit + session-revocation effects in one transaction.

operations.target_resolution: New Identity created only inside AcceptInvitation (new person) or the tenant-bootstrap procedure.
preconditions: Email match never links to or creates a duplicate Identity (IDN-2, OQ-IDN-4)
operations.audit_on_success: Covered by invoking operation audit (IDN-16).

operations.target_resolution: Invitation target is a prospective person; scope is the requested (organizationId, locationId) tuple.
preconditions: Invitation to an email bound to an offboarded Identity is rejected, creating no Invitation (IDN-20)
Response is indistinguishable for known/unknown email (OQ-IDN-7)
Delivery requires an approved email provider (OQ-TXN-2 residual); until then invitations can be created but not delivered
operations.audit_on_success: InviteIdentity audit in same transaction.
operations.blocking_note: identity_invitations has no email/recipient column at baseline; recipient storage needs schema admission.

operations.target_resolution: Invitation resolved by ID, then checked: invitation scope tuple must be within actor scope; otherwise 404.
preconditions: Only PENDING -> REVOKED (IDN-24); acceptance secret unusable in the same transaction (IDN-28)
operations.idempotency_proposed: STATE_GUARDED: repeat on REVOKED returns 409 with no side effect
operations.audit_on_success: RevokeInvitation audit in same transaction.

operations.target_resolution: Invitation resolved from the presented acceptance secret verifier. An already-authenticated Identity may accept only after explicit reauthentication (same rule as OQ-IDN-4).
preconditions: Invitation PENDING and unexpired (IDN-27)
Membership created only through Organization CreateMembership command boundary (IDN-27)
operations.idempotency_proposed: SERVER_DERIVED from invitation ID (second consumption fails, IDN-10)
operations.audit_on_success: AcceptInvitation + CreateMembership (+ CreateIdentity if new) audits in one transaction.
operations.orchestration: explicit cross-domain orchestration, Identity application layer (APP-8)

operations.target_resolution: Token resolved by ID; bound identity must be in actor visibility (MGR-3 for manager); otherwise 404.
preconditions: Only ACTIVE -> REVOKED (IDN-26)
operations.audit_on_success: RevokeSingleUseToken audit.
operations.blocking_note: No registered command ISSUES SetupToken/PasswordResetToken; revocation is grantable but issuance requires a C01 semantic change.

operations.target_resolution: Identity resolved by ID through actor organization memberships; otherwise 404.
preconditions: Only ACTIVE -> INACTIVE (IDN-21)
GLOBAL-EFFECT GUARD: every non-REVOKED Membership of the target belongs to the actor organization
operations.audit_on_success: DeactivateIdentity + IdentityDeactivated + session revocation in one transaction.
operations.blocking_note: Multi-organization targets are BLOCKED pending the global Identity lifecycle policy recorded under OQ-TEN-3.

operations.target_resolution: Identity resolved by ID through actor organization memberships (including INACTIVE memberships); otherwise 404.
preconditions: Only INACTIVE -> ACTIVE (IDN-21)
Same GLOBAL-EFFECT GUARD as DeactivateIdentity
operations.audit_on_success: ReactivateIdentity + IdentityReactivated in one transaction.

operations.target_resolution: Manager: target must be a direct report within the location scope (MGR-3, registered by #74). org_admin: any member of the organization.
preconditions: One shared identity lifecycle service (IDN-17, MGR-8)
Same GLOBAL-EFFECT GUARD as DeactivateIdentity
operations.idempotency_proposed: CLIENT_SUPPLIED key; repeat returns same final state and original timestamp (IDN-19)
operations.audit_on_success: OffboardIdentity + IdentityOffboarded + revocations in one transaction (IDN-18).
operations.blocking_note: Multi-organization targets BLOCKED (OQ-TEN-3 global-lifecycle policy). Manager grant is empty until ReportingRelationship is registered.
operations.orchestration: explicit cross-domain orchestration, Identity application layer (APP-8)

operations.target_resolution: Session resolved by ID and must belong to the session identity; otherwise 404. Logout targets the presented session.
preconditions: Only ACTIVE -> REVOKED (SES-20)
Logout response expires the cookie (SES-13)
Unsafe method: Origin check required (OQ-SES-5)
operations.idempotency_proposed: STATE_GUARDED: replay of a revoked cookie returns 401
operations.audit_on_success: RevokeApplicationSession audit (atomic session audit already connected at baseline).

operations.target_resolution: Invoked by AcceptInvitation (or tenant bootstrap) with the invitation's bound scope tuple.
preconditions: New Membership starts ACTIVE (TEN-18)
operations.audit_on_success: Covered by invoking operation audit.

operations.target_resolution: Membership resolved by ID; manager: membership location equals actor location AND member is a direct report. Otherwise 404.
preconditions: Only ACTIVE -> INACTIVE (TEN-18)
operations.audit_on_success: DeactivateMembership + MembershipDeactivated in one transaction.

operations.target_resolution: Membership resolved by ID within actor organization; otherwise 404.
preconditions: Only INACTIVE -> REVOKED; REVOKED terminal (TEN-18, TEN-19)
operations.audit_on_success: RevokeMembership + MembershipRevoked in one transaction.

operations.target_resolution: Learner resolved by ID through MGR-3 visibility (manager) or org membership (org_admin); ContentPack version resolved by exact version/digest (CNT-2). Otherwise 404.
preconditions: ContentPack version published and valid (CNT-3, CNT-4)
ContentPack available to the organization (ownership scope UNDEFINED — see PublishContentPack)
operations.audit_on_success: AssignContent + ContentAssigned audit (MGR-7).
operations.blocking_note: Usable only after ContentPack ownership/availability scope is defined in C31.

operations.target_resolution: Assignment resolved by ID; must be assigned to the session identity within an ACTIVE learner Membership; otherwise 404.
preconditions: Assignment ACTIVE and content version valid (LRN-2)
Requires connectivity (LRN-12)
operations.audit_on_success: StartLearningSession + LearningSessionStarted.

operations.target_resolution: LearningSession resolved by ID; must belong to session identity; otherwise 404.
preconditions: Session ACTIVE (LRN-3)
Event records content identity + version (LRN-10)
operations.audit_on_success: ProgressRecorded fact; audit only if classified security-sensitive (not by default).

operations.target_resolution: LearningSession resolved by ID; must belong to session identity; otherwise 404.
preconditions: Only ACTIVE -> COMPLETED (LRN-3)
operations.audit_on_success: CompleteLearningSession + LearningSessionCompleted.

operations.target_resolution: Undefined: C31 does not state whether a ContentPack is organization-owned or a global catalog item.
preconditions: Pack validates against declared schema version (CNT-3)
operations.audit_on_success: N/A
operations.blocking_note: A global-catalog publish would be a cross-tenant platform capability, which AUTHZ-20 forbids. Requires a C31/C13 decision on ContentPack ownership scope; an AutomationActor content-release principal is one candidate (AGT-1).

operations.target_resolution: Learner resolved by ID; must hold ACTIVE learner Membership in the same organization and location; otherwise 404.
preconditions: Actor != learner (CERT-15)
Active learner membership and active assignment (CERT-1, CERT-2)
Approved criteria version bound (CERT-4) — impossible until OQ-CERT-2 is resolved
Evidence: checklist + observation note only (OQ-CERT-3)
operations.audit_on_success: IssueCertification + CertificationIssued atomically (CERT-9).
operations.blocking_note: Every request fails closed with 409 PRECONDITION_FAILED until OQ-CERT-2 supplies an approver and an approved criteria version exists.

operations.target_resolution: Certification resolved by ID within actor organization; otherwise 404.
preconditions: Reason required; record preserved (CERT-11, CERT-12)
operations.audit_on_success: RevokeCertification + CertificationRevoked.

operations.target_resolution: ReconciliationRecord resolved by ID; principal must be registered for the record's operation_name.
preconditions: Record OPEN; resolves only after canonical provider readback (TXN-7, TXN-14)
operations.audit_on_success: Reconciliation audit with actor type + execution identity (AGT-14).
operations.blocking_note: No AutomationActor principal is registered (OQ-AGT-1). No human tenant role receives this capability.
